newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures fall limit, slow cash trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures fall limit, slow cash trade.

text.p: January and March CME lumber futures fell the daily limit of $10.00 per thousand board feet on selling prompted by slow cash lumber sales, traders said.
January was off limit at $399.50 per tbf and March off limit at $384.60. Other months were down $5.40 to $3.50.
Monday's late rally and early carryover buying also met technical resistance at $412 in January.
Demand for wood is slow, especially with poor weather cutting demand in parts of the country, traders added.
